wiki_article:
**AI Overview Capture Registry — June 2026 (v6.1)** is a dataset by Lee Sharks dated 14 June 2026, deposited as a **structured JSON-LD dataset** rather than a prose document.

Its body opens as a `schema.org` Dataset declaration, which is the deposit's method: the registry is published in a form machines index directly, so that a corpus documenting machine composition is itself legible to the systems it observes. That reflexivity is deliberate throughout the archive's capture programme.

Version 6.1 precedes the 7.x series deposited the following day (#1398, #1401). The archive keeps each version as its own deposit because the registry is evidence — a capture cited from v6.1 must remain findable in v6.1, and a growing instrument that overwrites its states destroys the citability its own findings depend on.

version_field_repair.basis: Decided by reading, not inference. The title reads EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 v6.1, 87 captures; the body's own JSON-LD Dataset block declares "version": "6.1"; the registry field said v7.2. Two independent declarations against one, and v7.2 is a different edition of this registry — the v7.2 editions are the 131-capture ones at #1396 and #1401. A reader landing here was told the record was both v6.1 and v7.2.

FORENSICS PREFIX LIFTED OUT OF THE DESCRIPTION. The field opened with the severed DOIs and the Zenodo removal record — date, reason, and the numeric ID of the account that removed it — before saying anything about the work. That is provenance, and it is now held in provenance_note where it belongs; the description now opens with the work. The trailing 'json; if canonical bytes surface, a full-text version supersedes this record' fragment was also removed: it is a truncation artifact, and false on a record that holds its full text.
